route_title: 27-Layer Chirped Defect-Cavity Filter with Linear Quarter-Wave Scaling
compilation_rationale: Compiler applies the explicit topology override to instantiate exactly 21 finite coating layers between air and fused silica. Initial thicknesses follow the prescribed quarter-wave/half-wave optical scaling at 1550 nm, with bounds clamped to 50–350 nm for mirrors and 400–700 nm for the cavity. Three weighted transmission targets enforce passband maximization at 1550 nm and stopband suppression in the flanking windows.
